summary: Novo Nordisk A/S filed a 6-K reporting progress under its open-market share repurchase programme authorized up to DKK 15 billion over 12 months. The current tranche targets up to DKK 3.8 billion through May 4, 2026. As of April 17, 2026, the company repurchased 12.3 million B shares at an average price of DKK 256.87 per share (approx. transaction value DKK 3.15 billion), now holding 28.4 million treasury shares (0.6% of share capital). No board recommendation or advisor is named. The programme is conducted under EU Safe Harbour Rules. What to watch: execution pace and cumulative buyback impact on EPS and share count.
